issues.description: A short stroke protrudes from F below and to the right of the vertex, past the baseline. The original ends the A-F line and the F-E baseline at F with no tail. This comes from the GeoTailF segment (F to (-0.366,-1.867)).
issues.suggestion: Remove the line `\draw (F) -- (GeoTailF);` and the GeoTailF coordinate, or shorten it so it does not extend beyond F.

issues.description: The dashed perpendiculars look slightly lighter than in the original, where the dashes read as heavier. This is a minor difference and may be within rendering tolerance.
issues.suggestion: Optionally use a slightly thicker dash pattern (e.g. line width 1.0pt on the dashed draws). No change required.
